entry.signinLead: Sign in with your phone number. Kiorex Passport sends you a one-time code; there is no password.
entry.joinLead: Join with your phone number. It takes about a minute, and we ask for no medical information.
entry.s1: Kiorex Passport checks your phone number with a one-time code.
entry.s2: You come back here and tell us a little about you. Every step is optional.
entry.s3: You land on your home, ready to find care.
entry.passportNote: Passport is Kiorex's sign-in service. Your phone number is the only thing it needs.
entry.providersQ: Are you a clinic, pharmacy or lab?
entry.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled and nothing was changed. You can try again whenever you are ready.
entry.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again and we will bring you back to where you were.
entry.required: Sign in to continue. We will bring you back to where you were.
entry.error: Something went wrong while signing you in. Please try again.
entry.unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
entry.marketSoon: Booking in {{country}} opens when the market launches. You can create your account and browse now.

welcome.title: Set up Kiorex
welcome.saveError: We could not save this step. Check your connection and try again.
welcome.loadError: We could not load your account. Try again.

welcome.title: Welcome to Kiorex
welcome.body: A few quick choices make Kiorex yours. Everything here is optional, nothing asks for medical information, and you can change any of it later in your account.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.body: Doctors and clinics see this name on your bookings.
name.label: Your name
name.hint: As you want it on your appointments

language.title: Language and place
language.body: Choose your language, and where you are looking for care.
language.soonNote: Booking in this country opens when it launches. You can still browse and keep your account.

interests.title: What care are you interested in?
interests.body: Pick any that fit. We use them to arrange your home screen. No health details.

privacy.title: Your privacy choices
privacy.body: Kiorex never uses health details for measurement. Decide if we may measure how the app is used so we can improve it.
privacy.analytics: Help improve Kiorex by measuring how I use it
privacy.service: Booking confirmations, receipts and sign-in codes always reach you; they are not optional.
privacy.link: Read the full list of choices

notify.title: How may we reach you?
notify.body: Visit reminders are helpful. Offers are optional and nothing is ticked for you.
notify.notAvailable: Offers are not being sent yet. Your choice is saved for when they start.

done.title: You are all set
done.body: Your home is ready. You can change any choice in your account at any time.
done.skippedBody: No problem. You can finish it from your home whenever you like.

home.finishSetupBody: Add your name and choose how we may reach you. It takes a minute.
